paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : IWSLT14 De
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the BLEU score performance of four different models as a function of Average Lagging (AL) on the IWSLT14 De dataset. The x-axis represents Average Lagging (AL), ranging from 2.5 to 10.0 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis represents BLEU score, ranging from 26 to 34 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 1. Four lines are shown: a red solid line with star markers labeled "Consistency-Bi", a blue dashed line with square markers labeled "Inconsistency-CE-MP", a purple dashed line with square markers labeled "Inconsistency-CE", and a purple dotted line with circle markers labeled "Consistency-CE". The red line starts at approximately 30.5 BLEU at AL=3.5 and increases to about 33.0 at AL=10.0. The blue dashed line starts at 27.0 BLEU at AL=2.5 and rises to approximately 32.0 at AL=10.0. The purple dashed line begins at 26.0 BLEU at AL=2.5 and increases to about 31.0 at AL=10.0. The purple dotted line starts at 26.0 BLEU at AL=2.5 and rises to approximately 31.0 at AL=10.0. All lines show an upward trend as AL increases, with the red line consistently achieving the highest BLEU scores across all AL values.
